s1: Every day, NASA satellites record where Earth burns. But that record is split in two.
s2: MODIS sees coarse pixels. VIIRS sees four times more fire. Splice them, and history breaks.
s3: Ember Almanac learns a local exchange rate where they overlap, and rebuilds one consistent record.
s4: Draw any area to read its burning calendar: when fire peaks, and which years broke the pattern.
s5: Ember Almanac. One fire record, for any place on Earth.
